rule.pl: Kazda istotna zmiana, test, awaria, rollback, nowy modul, nowa czesc i decyzja projektowa trafia na WWW. Nie polegamy na pamieci czatu.
rule.en: Every significant change, test, failure, rollback, new module, new part and project decision is documented on the web. Chat memory is not the source of truth.

mandatory_www_targets.name: Public Source of Truth
mandatory_www_targets.role: Durable public history and project state

mandatory_www_targets.name: Kora Master Panel
mandatory_www_targets.role: Primary Pi-side project state, modules and changelog

mandatory_www_targets.name: Kora Live
mandatory_www_targets.role: Live runtime view; must also expose a concise current-work summary

mandatory_www_targets.name: Kora Live JSON
mandatory_www_targets.role: Machine-readable live runtime; must also expose a concise documentation/current-work field

documentation_sync_rule.pl: Po kazdej istotnej pracy aktualizujemy publiczny Source of Truth, Master Panel, Live i Live JSON. Na WWW publikujemy opis i status, bez wklejania kodu.
documentation_sync_rule.en: After every significant work item, update the public Source of Truth, Master Panel, Live and Live JSON. Publish summaries and status on the web, not source code.

status_policy.WORKING: Only after a successful real functional/voice test.
status_policy.CODE_OK: Code compiles or passes static checks, but real test is still pending.
status_policy.TESTING: Installed or prepared and currently under real-world testing.
status_policy.FAILED: Real test failed or caused a regression.
status_policy.ROLLED_BACK: The failed change was reverted to the previous known state.

current_priority.title: Complete spoken-answer path and begin controlled walking tests
current_priority.details_pl: Wake word uruchamia odpowiedź wstępną, ReSpeaker XVF3800 nagrywa, ale pełna odpowiedź po pytaniu głosowym nadal wymaga potwierdzenia. Metalowe nogi wykonały pierwszy widoczny ruch; chodzenie nie jest jeszcze potwierdzone.
current_priority.details_en: The wake word triggers an acknowledgement and ReSpeaker XVF3800 records, but the full answer after a spoken question still needs confirmation. The metal legs produced their first visible movement; walking is not confirmed yet.
